moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Fake Out
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: 40
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 3
Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.

moves.name: Sheer Cold
moves.description:
Ice (Special)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 30
Priority: 0
Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + X)%, where X is 30 if the user is an Ice type and 20 otherwise, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Ice-type Pokemon and Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.

moves.name: Role Play
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
The user's Ability changes to match the target's Ability. Fails if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, Zero to Hero, or already matches the target, or if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

moves.name: Freeze-Dry
moves.description:
Ice (Special)
Base Power: 70
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. This move's type effectiveness against Water is changed to be super effective no matter what this move's type is.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: -7
For 5 turns, the Speed of every Pokemon is recalculated for the purposes of determining turn order. During the effect, each Pokemon's Speed is considered to be (10000 - its normal Speed), and if this value is greater than 8191, 8192 is subtracted from it. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description:
Psychic (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description:
Ice (Special)
Base Power: 110
Accuracy: 70
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. If the weather is Snow, this move does not check accuracy.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description:
Ice (Special)
Base Power: 90
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

moves.name: Frost Breath
moves.description:
Ice (Special)
Base Power: 60
Accuracy: 90
Priority: 0
This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.

items.name: Mental Herb
items.description: Cures holder of Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, Torment. Single use.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Iron Ball
items.description: Holder is grounded, Speed halved. If Flying type, takes neutral Ground damage.

items.name: Quick Claw
items.description: Each turn, holder has a 20% chance to move first in its priority bracket.

items.name: Colbur Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Dark-type attack. Single use.

items.name: King's Rock
items.description: Holder's attacks without a chance to make the target flinch gain a 10% chance to make the target flinch. Evolves Poliwhirl into Politoed and Slowpoke into Slowking when traded.

items.name: Occa Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Fire-type attack. Single use.

abilities.name: Screen Cleaner
abilities.description: On switch-in, the effects of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, and Reflect end for both sides.

abilities.name: Ice Body
abilities.description: If Snow is active, this Pokemon restores 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn.

abilities.name: Tangled Feet
abilities.description: This Pokemon's evasiveness is doubled as long as it is confused.
